scientific_scope.parameter_conditions: Constant Omega and delta; constant gamma and epsilon with gamma, epsilon >= 0; hbar = 1.

scientific_scope.central_result: The restricted generator is -i[delta Z_L, rho_L] + 2 epsilon D[Z_L]rho_L; the coherence is c(0) exp(-4 epsilon t - 2 i delta t).
scientific_scope.independent_noise_boundary: Independent dephasing preserves the logical support but decays its coherence at rate 4 epsilon.
scientific_scope.source_note_handling: Retained the independent-dephasing term and supported-initial-state condition. Omitted unrelated defensive statements about universal noise protection, fault-tolerant processors, and unperformed experiments.

checks.word_count_method: Whitespace-delimited words after removing displayed equations and headings; inline mathematical symbols remain counted.
mathematical_review: Collective-coupling eigenvalues on both logical basis states are zero.
Logical Hamiltonian eigenvalues are +delta and -delta, giving the stated negative phase for rho_01,10.
Each independent dissipator contributes -2 times the off-diagonal matrix unit; the two channels give -4 epsilon.
The encoded populations are constant and the |+_L> logical-X signal is exp(-4 epsilon t) cos(2 delta t).
